_doc: Data only (rule S1): judged by decide() in the fake world of kill_guard_corpus.json, never executed or fed to a shell. shape names the BLOCK that found it: a commit hash for the six earlier fixes, with only rows that fix's parent let through, F6-F9 for the closed grammar, R2-R5 for later reviews, PKILL for goodqa#14617, OK for commands that must keep working. RR, TC, AH and RROK cover tag loss on re-parse, text-carried kills and array heads (goodqa#14691, goodqa#14683). WS, WV, VH and WSOK cover a pipe into a wrapped remote shell and a variable or array holding several words (goodqa#14712).
